name: Default
shortDescription: Web application that archives, searches and exports email from IMAP, Microsoft 365 and imported mailboxes, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from this app's environment settings; the app then makes you set a new password. The admin account is created only on the first start, so editing ADMIN_PASSWORD later has no effect. Keep CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY unchanged, or the stored mailbox credentials have to be entered again.
